meta.purpose: Items that did not verify cleanly, or were corrected, in the 2026-11-26 line-by-line audit (task T12). Rendered on flagged.html. Each entry carries the source links used. Blank or flagged means NOT verified; nothing here is an estimate presented as fact.

flags.title: Venetian 'cheapest week' figures withdrawn
flags.where: The Venetian Resort: hotels.json, price-windows.json, questions Q-06, suggestion S-01, index card, executive summary, README
flags.what: The stored captures $3,757 (15–22 Feb 2027) and $2,407 (8–15 Mar 2027) for the Venetian's 60 m² Luxury King Suite (about 646 ft²) could not be reproduced. On 26 Nov 2026 Booking.com's own Venetian page showed the same suite at US$5,185.05 for 15–22 Feb 2027 (list US$9,934; 'Bonusrabatt' −48%) and €4,472.36 for 8–15 Mar 2027 (list €6,479; −31%), both labelled 'including taxes and fees'. The March page was displayed in EUR and no conversion was applied. Even at €1 = $1 the March figure is about 86% above the stored $2,407.
flags.effect: Venetian totals are withdrawn (shown as —). The '36% cheaper in March' claim is removed from the index, executive summary, questions and suggestions. The 25 Nov captures are kept in hotels.json under prices_withdrawn_2026_11_26 for audit.

flags.title: Per-night and 7-night totals do not reconcile
flags.where: 16 properties; 17 of 42 captured rows (see each hotel card)
flags.what: On these rows, total ÷ 7 differs from the stated per-night figure by more than 3%. Examples: Flamingo $626 total but $39/night (×7 = $273); Palms Place $866 total but $80/night (×7 = $560); Cosmopolitan Mar $2,307 total but $275/night (×7 = $1,925). The capture does not say whether the per-night figure excludes taxes/fees or the total includes them.
flags.effect: Both figures are shown as captured. Do not divide one by seven or multiply the other. The basis of each row must be checked on the property's own booking engine.

sources.label: Booking.com, The Cosmopolitan (stored booking_url; the 8–15 Mar capture uses the same URL pattern with 2027-03-08 → 03-15)

flags.title: Palms Place room specification not confirmed on the official site
flags.what: 'Studio with Mountain View, 603 ft², king + sofa bed, private bathroom' comes from the Booking.com rate block. The Palms pages fetched on 26 Nov 2026 (/palms-place and /stay) did not state room size, bed or bathroom in the captured text.
flags.effect: Treat the room as unverified until the bed and bathroom are confirmed on Palms' own booking page before relying on the queen-or-larger requirement.

flags.title: Route 203 Decatur to Las Vegas Blvd is a range, not 14 minutes
flags.where: transit.html, travel_matrix.json, transit.json, executive summary and README
flags.what: RTC's weekday timetable for Route 203 (eastbound, first two of six PDF pages read in this audit) gives Decatur to Las Vegas Blvd running times of about 10 to 17 minutes depending on the run. The 14-minute figure used in the model is a midpoint, not a published value. Update: a Saturday westbound run on the PDF's third page shows Las Vegas Blvd to Decatur at about 8–9 minutes, so the sampled range is 8–17 minutes across directions and days; pages 4–6 are still unread.
flags.effect: Wording corrected everywhere. The model still uses 14 minutes, so the 34-minute north-Strip-to-Chinatown estimate is unchanged but should be read as a range that moves with the time of day. Still an estimate.

flags.title: Michael Mina (Bellagio) closure re-confirmed
flags.what: Bellagio's own dining index lists Michael Mina as 'Temporarily Closed' ($$$$, seafood). This re-confirms F-23 on a second page. No reopen date is published.
flags.effect: The $590 for two is not a bookable dinner. Do not plan around it or sell Bellagio on it.

flags.where: Palazzo, Cosmopolitan, ARIA, Bellagio, Waldorf Astoria, Nobu at Caesars

flags.title: Repository irregularities found in the review
flags.where: Repository root, COORDINATION.md, README.md, executive-summary.md, pages/, data/
flags.what: (a) COORDINATION.md reuses task IDs: T10 appears twice and T1–T9 appears in two different session rows. (b) README.md and executive-summary.md gave 8 pages and 280 external links; the generator renders 11 pages with 288 external links (scripts/validate.py). (c) Three Michelin datasets and three hotel datasets hold overlapping facts (canonical plus session-*). They agree on the 24 award names, but not on every hotel rate. The archived sub-sites docs/session-af795000/ and docs/session-48dbf0ae/ still carry their own price claims, including that February is the cheapest week; they were not updated by this audit and are not the canonical plan. (d) pages/flagged.html was an orphan page, linked from no navigation and generated by no script. It is replaced by the generated flagged.html. (e) data/flags.json uses F07-style IDs; FLAGS.md uses F-07. (f) A 'pages build and deployment' run on branch arena/48dbf0ae-vegas1 failed (run 45643448267). That branch is not main, and main's Pages builds succeed.
flags.effect: Items (b) and (d) are fixed in this audit. Items (a), (c), (e) and (f) are logged for a human decision on which copy to keep.
